operation.summary: Host and owner-configured external devices, supported actions and access status
operation.returns: devices: host Android device, cameras visible to your lan_camera grant and your own LAN enrollments when lan_control is granted and enabled; SSH profiles when ssh is granted and enabled; ids, names, configured state, availability (not_checked until an action), advertised pan/tilt and exact action paths/bodies. No credentials. Inventory is passive and does not scan the LAN. lan_path: read-only status of the agent path for other LAN devices (speakers such as WiiM): discover, enroll and control steps with agent grant, owner switch, usable, endpoints and the number of this agent's enrolled devices; granting and approval stay with the owner.
